name: dataset-license-check
description: Check licences, restrictions and provenance of datasets and AI models before you use them: commercial use, training, redistribution, obligations and provenance risks, with evidence from Hugging Face cards, licence texts (SPDX, Creative Commons, OSI) and published provenance research. Clear verdict per intended use, a data-use register for due diligence and AI Act documentation, and scheduled re-checks. Not legal advice.
